title: Porsche bulletin 9702 - Hydraulic Valve Lifters (legacy source ID retained)
notes: Legacy record corrected on 2026-10-02: the linked publication is bulletin 9702, group 1559, dated 1997-01-28, about hydraulic valve lifters. It is not the OBD Engine Specifications document. Turbo standard lifter is 99310514103; size 1 is 99310514150 and size 2 is 99310514160. Earlier firing-order, 1.6 fan ratio, 1010 L/s cooling airflow and dry-sump specifications attributed to this bulletin are withdrawn. The separate Carrera Engine Specifications source is SRC-PORSCHE-993-ENGINE-SPECIFICATIONS-PUBSTACK; its numerical fan data are not accepted as M64.60 values. Historical source ID remains stable for existing references.
